R1_CRITICAL_LOAD_PRESERVATION.rationale: Zero tolerance for unserved life-safety and comms critical load; immediate mandatory shedding of non-critical loads

R2_THERMAL_SAFETY_CRITICAL.rationale: Indoor temperature has dropped below station minimum safe threshold; mandatory heating power prioritization

R3_THERMAL_SAFETY_WARNING.rationale: Indoor temperature is within warning buffer of minimum safe threshold; prepare thermal envelope and preheat

R4_RESERVE_EROSION_CRITICAL.rationale: Operating dependable reserve margin is below the 15% high-risk emergency limit; commit/prepare standby generator

R5_RESERVE_EROSION_WARNING.rationale: Operating dependable reserve margin is below 30% warning limit; elevated reserve observation active

R6_FUEL_EMERGENCY_PRESERVATION.rationale: Remaining bulk diesel fuel inventory has reached or breached the station critical emergency reserve threshold

R7_RESUPPLY_GAP_VULNERABILITY.rationale: Station projected fuel endurance cannot bridge the logistics gap until the next scheduled convoy delivery

R8_STORAGE_DEPLETION_WARNING.rationale: Battery state of charge is approaching the 20% minimum discharge cutoff; throttle discharge and preserve reserve

R9_STATION_RECOVERY_PROTOCOL.rationale: Station is transitioning out of acute critical stress; adopt recovery posture, confirm bus health, recharge storage

R10_NOMINAL_MONITORING.rationale: All station operational and life-safety parameters nominal; standard baseline monitoring posture

R11_DISCRETIONARY_LOAD_MITIGATION.rationale: Station under AT_RISK/THREATENED state with renewable generation failure; block discretionary loads to prevent escalation

R12_GOVERNANCE_ESCALATION.rationale: Critical compound station emergency or survival horizon critically short (<= 6.0 h); mandatory governance escalation
